exposure: cesarean delivery for fetal heart rate concerns
cohort: 45,475 infants born between March 2012 and April 2022 at a large teaching hospital
finding: This large, population-based study provides benchmark values for umbilical cord gas and lactate levels, stratified by delivery mode, and suggests that uncomplicated labor does not generally lead to clinically significant fetal hypoxia.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by elective cesarean delivery without labor had a lower median arterial umbilical cord pH (7.28) than previously assumed, and there was no difference in acid-base status among infants delivered by cesarean delivery for fetal heart rate concerns.
